solution_files.leap.pl:
:- use_module(library(lists)).

% Divisible by 4, but not by 100 unless by 400.
leap(Year) :-
    divisible_by(Year, 4),
    (\+ divisible_by(Year, 100) ; divisible_by(Year, 400)).

divisible_by(Year, N) :- Year mod N =:= 0.
